column3: Close to the Hebrew; “All his being afflicted” is rendered “All his affliction,” and “to David” as “on David’s behalf.”
The oath formula “if I go into the tent of my house” is rendered “Surely I will not enter my house”; “the couch of my beds” becomes “my bed.”
Close to the Hebrew; The oath formula “if I give sleep” is rendered “I will not give sleep.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The fields of Jaar” is rendered “the field of Jaar.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Faithfulness” is rendered “A truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Food” is rendered “bread.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will make a horn grow for David” is rendered “I will cause the horn of David to spring forth.”
